newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukrainian president cracks down on tax evaders.
newsitem.headline: Ukrainian president cracks down on tax evaders.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma, determined to collect billions of hryvnia in revenues from wayward regional governments and state enterprises, on Friday issued a strongly-worded decree ordering them to pay up.

"Government contracts which are signed by state enterprise directors will be changed to ensure that taxes, debts to the state budget and employees are paid, and failure to comply will render the contracts null and void," the four-page decree said.

The directive estimated unpaid debts to the state budget equalled Ukraine's growing 4.2 billion hryvnia ($2.2 billion) wage debt owed to government workers, teachers and doctors, who plan a nation-wide rally on March 18 to demand salary payment.
The government will also create special commissions to supervise payment of taxes by regional governments in the country of 51 million people, where tax dodging has become widespread.
